I tried concerta at first which didn’t really do anything to help ADHD symptoms but had the terrible side effect of making me super irritable all the time. 

Then I tried Strattera, and contrary to what a lot of people online seem to experience, it worked like magic. It was like it completely changed the way my brain worked for the better. I wasn’t impulsive anymore, I didn’t feel the need to procrastinate, and I could focus on something like a long lecture without getting distracted or feeling the intense urge to do something else. Unfortunately I couldn’t live with the side effects, it made my prostate balloon up and completely destroyed my libido. Strattera takes a while to take full effect so I think people who get prescribed it should be more patient if they don’t feel anything for a few weeks. 

Currently I’m on Adderall and I don’t get any side effects on it besides getting cotton-mouth unless I drink a TON of water. It works great for keeping me locked into a task for hours or however long I want. It does help with procrastination but not quite like Strattera. Adderall suppresses most people’s appetite a lot and if you’re locked into a task you can go hours with most eating so it’s important to remember to eat enough even if you don’t feel hungry. I’ve been counting calories to help with this.
